title: Resource Group Module
description: Provisions one or more Azure Resource Groups. The input is a map where each key is the resource group name and each value is a configuration object.

resource_group_config.description: Configuration for a single Azure Resource Group.

location.description: Azure region where the resource group will be created (e.g. 'eastus2', 'westus2').

tags.description: Key-value tags to apply to the resource group.

lock.description: When true, applies a CanNotDelete management lock to prevent accidental deletion.

managed_by.description: Resource ID of the resource managing this resource group. Leave empty if not applicable.
